title: Nyakati na Hali (Theme 10: Kudhibiti itikadi za kidini na za kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses hu- for what is always done (with no person prefix: husoma) and -me- for what is complete and still true now (amesoma).
representations: a finished task shown (a closed book)
steps: Read the time words (kila siku, tayari).
contexts: controlling harmful beliefs: always telling the truth

board.say: Ni jambo la mazoea au limekamilika?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Juma huamka mapema" and "Juma ameamka."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kila asubuhi Juma ___ maji." Kwa nini "anahunywa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika hali ya mazoea, hu- hubeba wakati na hakuna kiambishi cha mtu: Juma hunywa maji.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mama ___ kupika chakula (sasa kiko tayari)." Kwa nini "alimaliza" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: -me- huonyesha kitendo kimekamilika na matokeo yake yapo sasa. -li- huonyesha kitendo cha zamani kilichopita.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kila Jumamosi Wanjiru ___ nguo." Kwa nini "anafua" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitendo kinachofanyika kila mara huandikwa kwa hu-: Wanjiru hufua nguo.
-me- huonyesha jambo limekamilika sasa; kwa wakati ujao tunasema nitakuwa nimemaliza.
